summary: Finished the export command under /app/tally: where evaluation, locale date patterns and group_sizes grouping, CRLF CSV quoting per spec, sort null placement, and .slice-NNN file naming. All unit tests pass except tests/test_export.py::test_split_into_files, which expects 'people-001.csv' and contradicts spec section 10.3 ('people.slice-001.csv'); I followed the spec and did not touch the tests.
